request.style: English, male baritone solo, somber and reflective, solo voice, organ, cello, flute, soft percussion, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In Hezekiah's fourteenth year,
The Assyrian king drew near.
Sennacherib attacked the land,
He took the strongholds in his hand.

[Verse]
From Lachish Hezekiah spoke,
"I have sinned, my sins I broke."
"Withdraw from me, I will pay,
Whatever you demand today."

[Verse]
Three hundred talents of silver stood,
Thirty talents of gold added to the wood.
He gave the silver found inside,
The house of the Lord, side by side.

[Verse]
From palace treasuries he drew,
Every coin that he knew.
The doors of the temple he stripped bare,
The gold he gave him there.

[Outro]
He gave the doors to the king of Assyria.
